messages:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: PD-INC-7219 — inference-gateway HTTP 5xx rate increased by 720% in the last 2m. Trigger: error_rate > 10% over 1m across prod-us-west clusters. Link: https://pagerduty.example/PD-INC-7219

oncall-sre: acked — taking ownership, will triage now. pinging infra-rotator if we need emergency scale.

observability-bot: top signals: 5xx% = 12.4, p50 latency = 210ms, connection reset errors spiked. Region: prod-us-west2. Affected routes: /v1/generate, /v1/healthz (high qps).

oncall-sre: initial look — dashboards show simultaneous short-lived spikes in /v1/healthz QPS; looks like a large number of clients ramped health checks -> backend connection churn -> proxy 502/504. Can someone confirm if we had a rollout?

deploy-bot: no deploys in the last 30m. Canary/rolling jobs show steady.

infra-rotator: copying logs from the edge LB: ```
# 1m aggregate
requests: 24k, 5xx: 2.8k, keepalive_reset: 18k, conn_open/s: 900
```

infra-rotator: my hypothesis: thundering-heartbeat — many customers hitting health endpoints at same time, exhausting proxy worker threads and causing downstream keepalive churn. Recommend quick mitigation: temporarily throttle health checks (edge), bump inference-gateway replicas, and enable conn reuse on proxy.

oncall-sre: okay - executing mitigation plan. Scaling inference-gateway now.

oncall-sre: `kubectl -n prod scale deploy/inference-gateway --replicas=12` — scaling from 4 -> 12.

eng-runtime: noted — adding an emergency connection pool increase on the runtime side to reduce churn. Applying QPS backpressure config to the proxy.

infra-rotator: submitting edge rule to drop or 429 requests to /v1/healthz from suspicious clients: `edgectl rate-limit --route "/v1/healthz" --threshold 50/s --action 429 --scope ip` — applied in 60s.

observability-bot: scaling reflected in metrics; replicas initializing. 5xx% trending down from 12.4 -> 7.1 in the last 2m. Keepalive_reset counts decreasing.

sre-lead: nice mitigation. oncall-sre, if numbers keep falling please start a quick post-incident note and flag customers who hit errors.

oncall-sre: will do. tagging customer-success for impact assessment.

customer-success: getting inbound messages — two customers reported transient failures for APIs that call /v1/generate. Both are reporting higher error rates for ~6m. We're preparing a proactive outreach template.

eng-runtime: pushed a runtime patch to increase accept queue and keepalive timeouts: `kubectl -n prod set env ds/runtime CONNECTION_REUSE=true KEEPALIVE_TIMEOUT=120` — rolling.

oncall-sre: observing 5xx% at 3.2 now. p95 latency improving. Looks stable but still watching for 10m.

pagerbot: escalation check: no PD escalations pending. Incident severity currently S2.

infra-rotator: note for follow-up: add edge-level heuristics to detect simultaneous healthcheck bursts and auto-splay responses. Also recommend we de-emphasize public /v1/healthz for heavy clients.

oncall-sre: handoff in 25m to next oncall (sre-lead). Will prepare summary: root cause likely thundering-heartbeat from external healthchecks causing proxy worker exhaustion -> downstream 5xx. Mitigations: edge rate-limit /v1/healthz, scale replicas, runtime keepalive tuning.

sre-lead: taking handoff early. please add quick timeline + commands you ran. I'll keep watching and escalate to S1 if customer impact widens.

oncall-sre: timeline snippet: ```
1778882222 pagerbot: PD-INC-7219 fired
1778882230 oncall-sre: ack
1778882240 infra-rotator: edge logs indicate keepalive_reset spike
1778882252 oncall-sre: scale inference-gateway -> 12
1778882260 infra-rotator: apply edge rate-limit /v1/healthz
1778882285 eng-runtime: runtime env tweaks applied
1778882599 observability-bot: 5xx% down to 3.2
```

customer-success: will send the proactive note to affected customers. Please share any public-safe incident blurb when available.

oncall-sre: public-safe blurb: "We observed a transient increase in 5xx errors caused by a high volume of healthcheck traffic which caused connection churn. We implemented rate-limiting and scaled capacity; normal service restored. If you see persistent errors please contact support."

sre-lead: adding follow-ups to backlog: (1) edge heuristic for healthcheck bursts, (2) make /v1/healthz low priority internally, (3) add alert rule to differentiate keepalive_reset vs model errors.

oncall-sre: closing active page — monitoring for 30m before full close. thanks all. :thumbsup:

pagerbot: PD incident auto-update: status=acknowledged, responder=oncall-sre, severity=S2, linked runbook=inference-5xx-thundering-heartbeat.

eng-runtime: quick note — there are a few clients still at high QPS (IP list sanitized). follow-up action: outreach + recommend knob to reduce healthcheck frequency.

customer-success: posting the outbound template to #customer-comms now.

sre-lead: handoff complete, will follow-up in regular incident review. :eyes:
